overview: A day heavy on AI and markets. Michael Burry is reportedly challenging Nvidia's chip-value claims while holding NVDA puts, OpenAI made its subscription models about 50% faster, and Reflection AI announced a large open-weights model. Crypto got a regulatory step forward with the CFTC opening public comment on rulemaking. Political posts from several accounts were skipped.
